services.name: Axe Throwing
services.desc: Our Mentor and Middleburg Heights locations now feature axe throwing, one of the more exciting group activities! Axe throwing is a great team-building activity that everyone will enjoy! Join the evolution! Projected axe targets are here! Projected targets, interactive games, and a bowling-like scoring system redefine the experience. All lanes lit with blacklights, featuring reactive targets and axes. Wear blacklight-reactive apparel and accessories to amp up the cosmic fun! Happening every Friday, from 5PM until closing, in both Mentor and Middleburg Heights locations. Axe throwing is hungry work. “Meet your food” both at Mentor Escape Room and Axe Throwing and Escape Room Middleburg & Axe
